plain_text:
The strategic goals can be based on the program niches developed during the
preplanning process. The strategic goals are the changes or human actions that
will result from the program or project. There can be as many strategic goals as the
organization can accomplish during the time frame established in the strategic plan.

plain_text:
The objectives establish the standards of achievement in terms of some
proportionate improvement in the existing condition. Objectives are SMART
(specific, measurable, audience- or issue-directed, realistic and ambitious, and
time-bound). A strategic plan may list several objectives per goal.

plain_text:
Strategies are the composite of activities and outputs designed to achieve
outcomes. Strategic plans may have several strategies per objective.
